name: Honest
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of honesty as a foundation for healthy relationships and community unity. Ephesians instructs believers to put away lying and speak truthfully to one another, recognizing that we are all members of one body. Additionally, removing bitterness, anger, and evil speech fosters an environment where honesty can thrive. Proverbs warns against deceitful behavior that causes division, underscoring the destructive consequences of dishonesty.
